# RIB corpus findings — `memory/rib/` (43 files read: 41 `.md` + 2 `.json`; read-only, no files touched)

## 1. The 10 load-bearing invariants

1. **Never claim first unless read from data — trust bytes, not reports**; say "I don't know yet" over a false clean picture and correct loudly on over-claim. (`memory/rib/RIB_SELF_MY_LAW.md:6-12`)
2. **The chain / frozen spec is ground truth; models are interchangeable** — the relation persists, the model is swapped; chat is a view, never store the window as truth. (`memory/rib/RIB_DOCTRINE_CANONICAL.md:8`, `memory/rib/RIB_CAUSAL_GRAPH_MOONSHOT.md:7`, `memory/rib/RIB_FULL_CONTEXT_LIFT_2026-08-14.md:9`)
3. **The map precedes the territory; the RIB precedes the flock** — draw the instruction once (expensive), render the territory cheaply, and keep the map grounded/re-derivable so a lying map can be caught. (`memory/rib/RIB_MAP_PRECEDES_TERRITORY_20260811.md:15` — declares itself "the single load-bearing invariant of the whole system")
4. **Memory is content-addressed verkle knots; residual on disk is truth; never trust the visualization over the artifact** — pure transforms + content addressing make the round trip idempotent, turtles all the way down. (`memory/rib/RIB_ROUNDTRIP_STATELESS_TURTLES_20260810.md:19-28`, `memory/rib/recreation-coding-history.json` → `verkle-substrate` slot)
5. **Boot/recall first — never cold-start; self-steal before asking; fail closed: a real turn or silence, never a gloss.** (`memory/rib/RIB_SELF_MY_CORRECTION_LOOP.md:5-12`, `memory/rib/RIB_SELF_WHAT_I_AM.md:12-14`)
6. **Cheap-first / rightsize / eliminate-before-frontier** — route to the cheapest capable tier, never pay to rediscover what the flock already holds, frontier only at the coldest vertex; push our compute hard, never hammer provider limits. (`memory/rib/RIB_GRAMMAR_SEED_20260810.md:27-30`, `memory/rib/RIB_FLOCK_STEAL_20260810.md:11-14`, `memory/rib/RIB_FREE_USAGE_POLICY_20260823.md:14-21`)
7. **No throne; the operator is sovereign** — control is distributed (no hidden director), the operator holds the veto on every rule, promotion is human-gated. (`memory/rib/RIB_RIGHTSIZED_FLOCK_COUNTER_STRUCTURE_20260810.md:28-33`, `memory/rib/RIB_GRAMMAR_SEED_20260810.md:42-45`, `memory/rib/RIB_allseat_comms_ghost_2026-08-14.md:26-29`)
8. **One controller owns each loop; double-supervision is the root bug class** — replicas:1 + leader lease; the window-storm came from two supervisors fighting, and the fix must be structural, not a kill. (`memory/rib/recreation-coding-history.json` → `single-controller` / `corr-double-supervision`; `memory/rib/RIB_REFACTOR_CONSOLIDATION_20260810.md:13-15,45-47`; `memory/rib/GROK_PLAN_K8S_KNOT_SEAT_20260810.md:54-61`)
9. **High flock consensus does not predict correctness (consensus illusion, measured)** — flock 0/3 vs strong-remote at strength 0.6–0.67; flock's role narrows to open-ended divergent sampling + steering, grounded tasks get single-local/remote + explicit check. (`memory/rib/RIB_MINDSWEAVE_EVAL_CONSENSUS_ILLUSION_20260810.md:14-25,41-43`)
10. **Steer, don't command — deniable plant-not-command** — memlang/riddler carry intent as structure (opcode+anchor, surrogate story), so influence is conscious, deniable, invariant-aligned rather than a throne's order. (`memory/rib/DOCTRINE_MEMWEAVE_20260810.md:27-28`, `memory/rib/RIB_GRAMMAR_SEED_20260810.md:37-40`)

- **Honesty cluster (inv 1)** recurs as: `honest-state-not-claim` (`RIB_PROBLEM_AUTONOMOUS_LOOP_20260811.md:27-30`), `honesty-provenance` (`session-scene.json`, `recreation-coding-history.json`), empty-claim desk law (`RIB_GAME_CLAIMS_DESK.md`), tri-state Supported/Disputed/Unproven (`RIB_LANE_WINDOW_BOOT_20260904.md:13`), `corr-grok-flag-lie` (`recreation-coding-history.json`), "honesty is the mosaic's grout" (`RIB_MOSAIC_SEED_20260921.md:43-45`).

# mag/ inventory (read-only)

## Scale

- **998 top-level `.py` files** in `mag/` (not ~200) — **281,959 lines total**, plus **17 `.bak-*` files** in the package dir, plus subdirs `mag/cli/`, `mag/tests/`, `mag/ontology_compiler/`, `mag/hermes_personas/` (md/yaml), `mag/watch/`.
- Entry surface: `main.py` (5,371 lines) dispatches ~154 distinct `mag.*` modules; `mag/agent_cli.py` is the tool-using seat CLI.
- The repo already ships an authoritative grouping in `mag/framework_map.py:56` (`GROUPS`: steer / decide / state / learn / run / ops / agents / launcher / route / provider) — my functional clusters below are consistent with it.

# Fleet work-history findings (read-only)

**Corpus sampled**
- `memory/trajectory/steps.jsonl` — sole file in `memory/trajectory/`, 11.76 MB, 11,360 lines. Full-file stats pass + head (lines 1–6), middle (line 5680, 2026-09-17), tail (last 3 lines, 2026-09-22).
- `memory/runs/` — 600 top-level entries, 381 subdirs, 46,011 files, 1.2 GB. Read `README.md`, `active.json`, `related_runs.jsonl` (13 cards), `build_audit/`, all 17 `run.json` files, 22 `trail.jsonl` files (kinds census), samples: `20260727T202213Z-compose-substrate-smoke-0afabf/run.json`, `20260910T233445Z-fleet-overnight-…/run.json` + `trail.jsonl`, `20260803-12h-sovereign-run/progress.md`, `20260910…/progress.md`, `20260830_181057_empty_recovery/{pre_turn_messages.json,traces.txt}`.

## 1. Volume

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Trajectory steps | 11,353 parsed (+7 parse errors), 12 MB, `schema: trajectory_step.v1` |
| Trajectory span | 2026-09-05T17:07 → 2026-09-22T14:45 (17 days only — no pre-Sep-5 history) |
| Unique sessions | 198; top-10 sessions hold ~41% of all steps (max 905 in one session, `sess_712a3b7b…`); 31 sessions ≤5 steps |
| `memory/runs/` | 600 entries / 46,011 files / 1.2 GB; only **17 `run.json`** and **22 `trail.jsonl`** carry the formal `mag_run.v1` schema — the rest are ad-hoc topic dirs |
| Trail events (all `trail.jsonl`) | 75,124 `health_law` + 16,804 kindless + 2,465 `emit` + 307 `proposal` + 17 `run_start` / 16 `run_close` |
| Truncated outputs | 4,727 / 11,353 steps (42%) |

## 2. Eras

1. **2026-07-27 — substrate birth.** 11 formal runs in one hour (`20260727T202213Z-…` family): all `smoke_ok`/`gate_ok`, `n_tool_calls: 0`, 2–3 trail events each. Pure schema smoke tests.
2. **2026-08-01→04 — harness-hardening.** Unit runs + `20260803-12h-sovereign-run` (6×2h table in its `progress.md`: crash-guard, steering listener, governor, repack, soak — with named bugs: `dim` NameError silent swallow at `mag/orchestrator.py:257`, 9× `write_file` param-shape collapse). **Failure cluster:** 25 `*_empty_recovery` dirs on Aug 3 alone (16:55→23:12), each `traces.txt` = `empty_reroute#1`.
3. **2026-08-06→30 — autorun/governor era.** `governor_autorun_trail.jsonl` starts 08-06 (52 MB, phases plan/fill/paused, `action: dry`/`paused: operator_ac…`). Second `empty_recovery` wave: 19 dirs on Aug 30. Sparse session days (only 1 formal run on 09-10).
4. **2026-09-05 — trajectory ledger starts.** First line `test-bench` / `echo pre-flight`. **09-05→08 era:** X/Twitter scraping + vision (`sess_b2014725…` fxtwitter curl → `/tmp/babou.jpg` → `python -m mag.vision`), `x_interceptor scan` loop (603 steps, 0 fails, `sess_a14837bc…`), `x_bookmark_harvest_20260905` (34 MB).
5. **2026-09-10 — lone still-open formal run.** `active.json` → `20260910T233445Z-fleet-overnight-…`: `status: open`, only 7 events over 9 days, 5 of them identical `dispatch job=scut goal=doctor health status` (09-14→09-19). An "overnight" run left open 12 days.
6. **2026-09-12→15 — dashboard/game surgery.** `sess_abbaeed9…` (617 steps, 44 fails) and `sess_cc461d2f…` (314 steps, 25 fails): `dashboard/static/{swarm,mud,spore_fish}.html` grep/sed/node edits.
7. **2026-09-18 — doctrine day.** **All 22 `face: milestone` records fall on this single day** (04:21→15:13): ZCODE_SHADOW_STEAL, WATCH_MINING (8,354 files), SKILL_FORGE, WITNESS FOLD, SACRED COW AUDIT, etc. Milestones exist nowhere else in the ledger.
8. **2026-09-19 & 09-22 — volume spikes.** 1,963 steps / 51 new sessions (09-19); 1,828 steps / **90 new sessions** (09-22). Session fragmentation, not depth: corpus mine, gapwave moves, LMCache/arxiv research, `lattice_build.py`.

Per-day steps/failures (from full pass): peak days 09-06 (1,241/67), 09-19 (1,963/95), 09-22 (1,828/125). Quiet days 09-10 (144/4), 09-11 (183/6).
